findings.desc: agent:"lattice-review-concept" packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:429-456 implements closeout phase deadlines with Promise.race/setTimeout, but real wrapped closeout work still runs synchronously: git() uses execFileSync at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:199-204, runtimeChange calls synchronous git diff/comment scans at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:679-686, and cleanTree calls synchronous git status/classification at packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:1167-1174. While one of those synchronous operations is blocked, Node cannot run the timeout or heartbeat callbacks, so a real hung git/status/diff child can still outlive the phase deadline instead of failing closed by the independent deadline required by CHK-002/M2. The smoke only proves an async pending-promise injection at packages/main/src/tasks/done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke.ts:321-331, so it does not cover the real synchronous closeout hang path.
